items:
Luxury 2BR & 2BA townhouse (1,182 sqft) in the beautiful Prominence community on 30A with a resort style pool, BBQ grills, and bikes. Easy walk across the street to the Big Chill with restaurants, shops, play area for children and covered event pavilion for sports game, movie nights and concerts. Minutes to beach and pool is heated at 80F Oct 1-Nov 30, Dec 21-31, Mar 1-Apr 30 only.

-Savings tip, you can also find our listing here: https://houfy.com/239221

-Feel free to reach out for monthly rentals or any questions: carolyn168 @ hot mail or 626 234 7475

Located between Seagrove Beach and Seacrest. Minutes to Watersound, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Seaside and Watercolor. Equal distance and easy bike ride to Seaside and Rosemary Beach. Bike on 30A with 20 miles of bike trail.

Free high speed internet wifi and 3 Smart TVs with Roku that has Netflix, Hulu, YouTube TV, etc. Comes with cruiser bikes, bike lock, beach chairs, beach umbrellas, and beach toys in the garage. Good for couples, family and business travelers.

We provide a premium starter kit which includes essentials such as bath towels, toilet paper, paper towel, trash bags, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hand soap, dish detergent, dish tabs, sponge, kitchen towels, laundry detergent and dryer sheets. Please ensure that you bring beach towels and extra essentials as needed for your stay.

-NO one under 25 can rent. Parent must be on premise.
-NO pets. Animals are prohibited by owner because of family allergies.
-NO smoking allow inside the house.
-NO loud parties or events.
-NO trailer or uhaul onsite. Must fit inside single garage.

-Up to 30 carts will be available to rent short term on a first come basis, ONLY from 30A Gulf Carts. Contact Adam at 850 502 9325.

Beach Access:
1. Deer Lake State Park (6350 E County Hwy 30A) is a public beach access (1 mile west of Prominence) with parking lot, restroom, and shower. Need to pay $3 for parking and alcohol is not allowed as it's a state park. Longer walk from parking lot (5 mins) to the beach but a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with beautiful white sand dunes and less crowded than other public beaches. Easy bike ride (5 mins) or walk (25 mins) to the beach.

2. Gulf Lakes (8040 E County Hwy 30A) is a public beach access (1 mile east of Prominence) with bike parking and shower. No restroom and no parking lot but easy bike ride (5 mins) or walk (20 mins) to the beach.

3. Walton Dunes ((320 Beachfront Trail) is a public beach access with no stairs or ramp and can walk right up to beach (2.5 miles east of Prominence). No restroom. Parking for cars and golf carts.

4. Santa Clara Regional (3468 E County Hwy 30A) is a public beach access (about 3.5 miles west of Prominence) with a lifeguard, parking lot, and restroom as well as ADA access to the beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
